release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.28 reorganizes Tasks around retailer -> user-created drop group -> tasks, retires Fleet Control/Fleet Manager from the visible Tasks product while preserving the existing task engine and taskGroup records, and keeps grouped lifecycle actions on Tachyon's canonical per-task APIs. It also corrects the post-v0.45.27 UI regressions: restores Tachyon's graphite/blue brand treatment and semantic icon/emoji color instead of the over-applied monochrome look, reskins the update-available modal to match the current Tachyon visual system, hardens startup DOM writes when legacy nodes have been replaced or removed, and restores resilient Member announcement presence/recovery without exposing Owner-only controls in Member builds. Resource Groups account-field compatibility is now type-safe when newer Retailer Accounts owns the same field id, legacy hidden Fleet compatibility no longer calls the nonexistent evolution tasks bulk route, and grouped Tasks no longer installs the self-triggering subtree observer. This corrective release does not change the Owner/Member privilege boundary or updater transport model.
